result.reason: The operative language removes Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right and permits only 12-month renewals by mutual written agreement, while capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, satisfying the preferred position. The change is appropriately limited and leaves unrelated termination rights intact. Drafting quality is reduced by the unrepaired phrase in Section II (“mutual written of the parties”), redundancy among Sections I–III, and the lack of a defined CPI measure, though these issues do not defeat compliance.
